iti38:2.1: Tathāgataṃ bhikkhave arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ dve vitakkā bahulaṃ samudācaranti,
iti38:2.4: Tam-enaṃ bhikkhave tathāgataṃ avyāpajjhārāmaṃ avyāpajjharataṃ eseva vitakko bahulaṃ samudācarati:
iti38:2.5: Imāyāhaṃ iriyāya na kiñci byābādhemi tasaṃ vā thāvaraṃ vā ti.
iti38:3.2: Tam-enaṃ bhikkhave tathāgataṃ pavivekārāmaṃ pavivekarataṃ eseva vitakko bahulaṃ samudācarati:
iti38:4.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave tumhe pi avyāpajjhārāmā viharatha avyāpajjharatā.
iti38:4.2: Tesaṃ vo bhikkhave tumhākaṃ avyāpajjhārāmānaṃ viharataṃ avyāpajjharatānaṃ eseva vitakko bahulaṃ samudācarissati:
iti38:4.3: Imāya mayaṃ iriyāya na kiñci byābādhema tasaṃ vā thāvaraṃ vā ti.
iti38:5.2: Tesaṃ vo bhikkhave tumhākaṃ pavivekārāmānaṃ viharataṃ pavivekaratānaṃ eseva vitakko bahulaṃ samudācarissati:
iti38:5.3: kiṃ akusalaṃ kiṃ appahīnaṃ kiṃ pajahāmā-ti.
